quote_state.bid: latest BID tick at or before snapshot second
quote_state.ask: latest ASK tick at or before snapshot second
quote_state.freshness: both sides age <=2000 ms and ask>=bid>0

causal_feature_law.leader_impulse_units: log(leader_mid_t/leader_mid_t_minus_L)*10000 divided by leader median spread over t-60..t-1
causal_feature_law.leader_spread_filter: leader spread_t <= leader median spread baseline
causal_feature_law.follower_spread_filter: follower spread_t <= follower median spread baseline
causal_feature_law.structural_expected_direction: sign(leader impulse) multiplied by frozen relationship structural_sign
causal_feature_law.follower_lag_units: abs(log(follower_mid_t/follower_mid_t_minus_L)*10000) divided by follower median spread baseline
causal_feature_law.signal: both symbols fresh; abs(leader_impulse_units)>=frozen threshold; follower_lag_units<=0.5; both spread filters pass

execution_and_response.signal_time: integer second t after all leader and follower ticks timestamped <=t are processed
execution_and_response.entry: follower fresh side-aware quote at t+1 second
execution_and_response.exit: follower fresh side-aware quote exactly holding_seconds after entry
execution_and_response.overlap: one open event per relationship x frozen cell; later signals ignored until scheduled exit
execution_and_response.missing: any leader/follower signal state, entry or exit not fresh => skip/right-censor; no delay search/interpolation/stale repair

multiplicity.family: all 72 frozen relationship x lookback x threshold x horizon cells
multiplicity.support_rule_predeclared: all 72 remain family members; only cells meeting non-return support prerequisites generate finite max-T statistics; others p=1

robust_region_gate.adjacency: one step in lookback, impulse threshold or holding horizon

governance.robust_survivor_next_step: freeze a further disjoint DEVELOPMENT confirmation plus commission, volume lattice, margin and EUR200 gate before any candidate freeze
